milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate into the kitchen building and look at the smoker block placed at spawn-relative [6, 0, 9]. A max_distance of 5 ensures the player is inside the kitchen, and facing_tolerance of 60° confirms they are looking toward the smoker.

Uses inventory_has because mining a stone slab with a pickaxe causes it to drop as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with zero stone slabs, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining of the blocking slab.

Uses inventory_has with item='bowl' because eating mushroom stew always produces exactly 1 bowl as a byproduct. The player starts with no bowls and there is no other source of bowls in the scene, making this a definitive proof of consumption.
